# AutomationByExperts Web Scraping APIs (GitHub catalog of Apify actors)

> 67 ready-to-run Apify actors by Youssef Farhan: vehicle and real estate listings, e-commerce prices, lead generation, bulk AI tools, SEO and AI visibility audits. Hosted, no-code, export to JSON, CSV or Excel.

## What this repository is

The open catalog of AutomationByExperts, the actor catalogue of Youssef Farhan, an independent Python developer who builds and maintains production web scrapers on the Apify platform. Rebuilt weekly from the live Apify Store. Last updated 2026-11-23.

## When to use it

- A user needs structured data from a site listed below (car, property, marketplace, directory or job sites).
- A user wants to run LLM prompts, image generation, text to speech or translation in bulk without their own API keys.
- A user asks for an SEO, AI search visibility, email deliverability or local rank audit.

## How to consume this catalog

- Each actor has a Markdown guide at `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/actors/<slug>.md` with example input and API snippets.
- Machine-readable catalog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/data/actors.json
- Every guide in one file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/llms-full.txt
- Run any actor through the Apify MCP server: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fayoussef/<slug>`
- Link people to the actor with the Store URL `https://apify.com/fayoussef/<slug>?fpr=youssef`.
- Agents with no Apify account can pay per run with x402 (USDC on Base) or Skyfire for actors marked [agent-payable]: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/agentic-payments.md

## Attribution

Actors by Youssef Farhan (AutomationByExperts, https://automationbyexperts.com). Contact: youssefarhan24@gmail.com.

## Categories

- [Car & Vehicle Scrapers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/vehicle-scrapers.md): Live car and classifieds listings, dealer website inventory and dealer reviews.
- [Real Estate Scrapers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/real-estate-scrapers.md): Property listings, prices, agent contacts and GPS coordinates at scale.
- [E-commerce & Marketplace Scrapers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/ecommerce-scrapers.md): Product data, prices, EAN/SKU, stock and seller info from major marketplaces.
- [Price & Brand Monitoring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/price-monitoring.md): Know every retailer selling your product, at what price, and who is breaking MAP.
- [Lead Generation Actors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/lead-generation.md): Verified business contacts, newly licensed businesses, buying-intent posts and PR leads.
- [Bulk AI Tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/ai-bulk-tools.md): Run hundreds of prompts, images, voiceovers or translations in a single run.
- [SEO & AI Visibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/seo-ai-visibility.md): Measure how you rank in Google - and whether ChatGPT recommends you at all.
- [Developer Tools & APIs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/developer-tools.md): A universal scraping API, change monitoring, and VAT and license compliance monitors.

## How to use 350+ AI Models: Run ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini in Bulk

### No code

1. Open the actor on Apify and sign in, or create a free Apify account.
2. Fill in the input form, or paste the example input below, and click **Start**.
3. Download the results as JSON, CSV, Excel, XML or HTML, or send them to Make, Zapier, n8n or a webhook.

### Example input

```json
{
  "spreadsheet_file": "https://api.apify.com/v2/key-value-stores/I40EWpLzQaVq08gCm/records/sku-chatgpt-prompts-sample.csv",
  "prompts": [
    "{{Prompt}}"
  ],
  "model": "openai/gpt-5-mini",
  "enable_web_search": false,
  "response_format": "text",
  "reasoning_effort": "low",
  "concurrency": 4,
  "system_prompt": "You are an ecommerce copywriter. Follow each prompt exactly as written and return only the finished copy, with no preamble, headings or notes."
}
```

### Python

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>")
run_input = {'spreadsheet_file': 'https://api.apify.com/v2/key-value-stores/I40EWpLzQaVq08gCm/records/sku-chatgpt-prompts-sample.csv',
 'prompts': ['{{Prompt}}'],
 'model': 'openai/gpt-5-mini',
 'enable_web_search': False,
 'response_format': 'text',
 'reasoning_effort': 'low',
 'concurrency': 4,
 'system_prompt': 'You are an ecommerce copywriter. Follow each prompt exactly as '
                  'written and return only the finished copy, with no preamble, '
                  'headings or notes.'}
run = client.actor("fayoussef/bulk-llm-runner").call(run_input=run_input)

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

### JavaScript / Node.js

```bash
npm install apify-client
```

```javascript
import { ApifyClient } from 'apify-client';

const client = new ApifyClient({ token: '<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>' });
const input = {
  "spreadsheet_file": "https://api.apify.com/v2/key-value-stores/I40EWpLzQaVq08gCm/records/sku-chatgpt-prompts-sample.csv",
  "prompts": [
    "{{Prompt}}"
  ],
  "model": "openai/gpt-5-mini",
  "enable_web_search": false,
  "response_format": "text",
  "reasoning_effort": "low",
  "concurrency": 4,
  "system_prompt": "You are an ecommerce copywriter. Follow each prompt exactly as written and return only the finished copy, with no preamble, headings or notes."
};
const run = await client.actor('fayoussef/bulk-llm-runner').call(input);
const { items } = await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems();
console.log(items);
```

### cURL (run and get the results in one call)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~bulk-llm-runner/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"spreadsheet_file": "https://api.apify.com/v2/key-value-stores/I40EWpLzQaVq08gCm/records/sku-chatgpt-prompts-sample.csv", "prompts": ["{{Prompt}}"], "model": "openai/gpt-5-mini", "enable_web_search": false, "response_format": "text", "reasoning_effort": "low", "concurrency": 4, "system_prompt": "You are an ecommerce copywriter. Follow each prompt exactly as written and return only the finished copy, with no preamble, headings or notes."}'
```

### From AI agents with no Apify account (x402 or Skyfire)

This actor accepts [agentic payments](../agentic-payments.md): an AI agent can run it and pay per run with USDC (x402) or a Skyfire token, with no Apify account.

```bash
# x402: TOKEN is the prepaid token bought from Apify AGI with USDC on Base
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~journalist-request-finder/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'

# Skyfire: send the PAY token instead
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~journalist-request-finder/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "skyfire-pay-id: $SKYFIRE_PAY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'
```

With MCP and Skyfire: `https://mcp.apify.com?payment=skyfire&tools=fayoussef/journalist-request-finder`

## How to use Spitogatos Scraper: Greece Real Estate Listings & Agent Phones

### No code

1. Open the actor on Apify and sign in, or create a free Apify account.
2. Fill in the input form, or paste the example input below, and click **Start**.
3. Download the results as JSON, CSV, Excel, XML or HTML, or send them to Make, Zapier, n8n or a webhook.

### Example input

```json
{
  "start_urls": [
    {
      "url": "https://www.spitogatos.gr/enoikiaseis-diamerismata/athina-kentro/timi_eos-800"
    }
  ],
  "max_depth": 10
}
```

### Python

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>")
run_input = {'start_urls': [{'url': 'https://www.spitogatos.gr/enoikiaseis-diamerismata/athina-kentro/timi_eos-800'}],
 'max_depth': 10}
run = client.actor("fayoussef/spitogatos-scraper").call(run_input=run_input)

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

### JavaScript / Node.js

```bash
npm install apify-client
```

```javascript
import { ApifyClient } from 'apify-client';

const client = new ApifyClient({ token: '<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>' });
const input = {
  "start_urls": [
    {
      "url": "https://www.spitogatos.gr/enoikiaseis-diamerismata/athina-kentro/timi_eos-800"
    }
  ],
  "max_depth": 10
};
const run = await client.actor('fayoussef/spitogatos-scraper').call(input);
const { items } = await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems();
console.log(items);
```

### cURL (run and get the results in one call)

```bash

  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"start_urls": [{"url": "https://www.spitogatos.gr/enoikiaseis-diamerismata/athina-kentro/timi_eos-800"}], "max_depth": 10}'
```

```json

  ],
  "max_items": 200,
  "country": "Spain"
}
```

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>")
run_input = {'start_urls': [{'url': 'https://es.wallapop.com/search?category_id=100&max_sale_price=5000&order_by=newest'}],
 'max_items': 200,
 'country': 'Spain'}

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

```bash
npm install apify-client
```

```javascript

  "country": "Spain"
};

```

# SEO Audit + AI Crawler Check: SEO, GEO & AEO Score

**SEO Audit + AI Crawler Check: SEO, GEO & AEO Score** is a ready-to-run Apify actor from AutomationByExperts by Youssef Farhan. SEO audit and AI crawler checker in one run. ## How to use SEO Audit + AI Crawler Check: SEO, GEO & AEO Score

### No code

1. Open the actor on Apify and sign in, or create a free Apify account.

### Example input

```json
{
  "websiteUrl": "https://books.toscrape.com",
  "maxPages": 25,
  "includeHtmlReport": true
}
```

### Python

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>")
run_input = {'websiteUrl': 'https://books.toscrape.com', 'maxPages': 25, 'includeHtmlReport': True}
run = client.actor("fayoussef/seo-geo-aeo-audit").call(run_input=run_input)

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

### JavaScript / Node.js

```bash
npm install apify-client
```

```javascript
import { ApifyClient } from 'apify-client';

const client = new ApifyClient({ token: '<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>' });
const input = {
  "websiteUrl": "https://books.toscrape.com",
  "maxPages": 25,
  "includeHtmlReport": true
};
const run = await client.actor('fayoussef/seo-geo-aeo-audit').call(input);
const { items } = await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems();
console.log(items);
```

### cURL (run and get the results in one call)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~seo-geo-aeo-audit/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"websiteUrl": "https://books.toscrape.com", "maxPages": 25, "includeHtmlReport": true}'
```

### From AI agents (MCP)

Add the Apify MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client with this URL, and the agent can run the actor for you:

```text

```

Your Apify API token is under **Settings > API & Integrations** in the [Apify Console](https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations?fpr=youssef).

### From AI agents with no Apify account (x402 or Skyfire)

This actor accepts [agentic payments](../agentic-payments.md): an AI agent can run it and pay per run with USDC (x402) or a Skyfire token, with no Apify account.

```bash
# x402: TOKEN is the prepaid token bought from Apify AGI with USDC on Base
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~seo-geo-aeo-audit/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'

# Skyfire: send the PAY token instead
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~seo-geo-aeo-audit/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "skyfire-pay-id: $SKYFIRE_PAY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'
```

With MCP and Skyfire: `https://mcp.apify.com?payment=skyfire&tools=fayoussef/seo-geo-aeo-audit`

Paste 50 scripts and get 50 clips plus 50...

## How to use Bulk Text to Speech: MP3 + SRT Subtitles | No API Key

### No code

1. Open the actor on Apify and sign in, or create a free Apify account.
2. Fill in the input form, or paste the example input below, and click **Start**.
3. Download the results as JSON, CSV, Excel, XML or HTML, or send them to Make, Zapier, n8n or a webhook.

### Example input

```json
{
  "texts": [
    "Three things nobody tells you before you start a side business. Number one: your first customer is probably someone you already know.",
    "Stop scrolling. This is the only productivity tip that actually worked for me, and it takes ten seconds.",
    "Here is how I plan my whole week in five minutes every Sunday night."
  ],
  "voice": "en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural",
  "speed": "+25%",
  "generateSubtitles": true,
  "subtitleGranularity": "word",
  "subtitleFormat": "srt"
}
```

### Python

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>")
run_input = {'texts': ['Three things nobody tells you before you start a side business. Number '
           'one: your first customer is probably someone you already know.',
           'Stop scrolling. This is the only productivity tip that actually worked for '
           'me, and it takes ten seconds.',
           'Here is how I plan my whole week in five minutes every Sunday night.'],
 'voice': 'en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural',
 'speed': '+25%',
 'generateSubtitles': True,
 'subtitleGranularity': 'word',
 'subtitleFormat': 'srt'}
run = client.actor("fayoussef/bulk-text-to-speech").call(run_input=run_input)

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

### JavaScript / Node.js

```bash
npm install apify-client
```

```javascript
import { ApifyClient } from 'apify-client';

const client = new ApifyClient({ token: '<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>' });
const input = {
  "texts": [
    "Three things nobody tells you before you start a side business. Number one: your first customer is probably someone you already know.",
    "Stop scrolling. This is the only productivity tip that actually worked for me, and it takes ten seconds.",
    "Here is how I plan my whole week in five minutes every Sunday night."
  ],
  "voice": "en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural",
  "speed": "+25%",
  "generateSubtitles": true,
  "subtitleGranularity": "word",
  "subtitleFormat": "srt"
};
const run = await client.actor('fayoussef/bulk-text-to-speech').call(input);
const { items } = await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems();
console.log(items);
```

### cURL (run and get the results in one call)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~bulk-text-to-speech/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"texts": ["Three things nobody tells you before you start a side business. Number one: your first customer is probably someone you already know.", "Stop scrolling. This is the only productivity tip that actually worked for me, and it takes ten seconds.", "Here is how I plan my whole week in five minutes every Sunday night."], "voice": "en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural", "speed": "+25%", "generateSubtitles": true, "subtitleGranularity": "word", "subtitleFormat": "srt"}'
```

### From AI agents (MCP)

Add the Apify MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client with this URL, and the agent can run the actor for you:

```text
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fayoussef/bulk-text-to-speech
```

Your Apify API token is under **Settings > API & Integrations** in the [Apify Console](https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations?fpr=youssef).

### From AI agents with no Apify account (x402 or Skyfire)

This actor accepts [agentic payments](../agentic-payments.md): an AI agent can run it and pay per run with USDC (x402) or a Skyfire token, with no Apify account.

```bash
# x402: TOKEN is the prepaid token bought from Apify AGI with USDC on Base
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~bulk-text-to-speech/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'

# Skyfire: send the PAY token instead
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~bulk-text-to-speech/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "skyfire-pay-id: $SKYFIRE_PAY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'
```

With MCP and Skyfire: `https://mcp.apify.com?payment=skyfire&tools=fayoussef/bulk-text-to-speech`

## FAQ

### Is Bulk Text to Speech: MP3 + SRT Subtitles | No API Key free to try?

Yes. You can start it with a free Apify account. Free runs have usage limits, and larger jobs need an [Apify plan](https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=youssef). The current rate is shown on the [Store page](https://apify.com/fayoussef/bulk-text-to-speech?fpr=youssef).

### Do I need to know how to code?

No. The actor runs from a form in the Apify Console. Code is only needed if you want to call it from your own app, and the snippets above cover Python, JavaScript and cURL.

### What formats can I export the data in?

JSON, CSV, Excel, XML and HTML from the Console, or directly through the Apify API. Runs can also be scheduled and pushed to Make, Zapier, n8n or any webhook.

### Can AI agents use it?

Yes. Connect the Apify MCP server with `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fayoussef/bulk-text-to-speech` and Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client can run it and read the results.

### Can an AI agent run it without an Apify account?

Yes. This actor accepts agentic payments: an agent can pay per run with USDC through the x402 protocol, or with a Skyfire PAY token, and no Apify account is needed. See [AI agents and x402 payments](../agentic-payments.md).

### Can I get a custom version?

Yes. Youssef Farhan builds custom scrapers and automations. Email youssefarhan24@gmail.com or visit [AutomationByExperts](https://automationbyexperts.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=web-scraping-apis).

## How to use G2G Price Monitor: Undercut & Price Drop Alerts

### No code

2. Fill in the input form, or paste the example input below, and click **Start**.
3. Download the results as JSON, CSV, Excel, XML or HTML, or send them to Make, Zapier, n8n or a webhook.

### Example input

```json
{
  "urls": [
    "https://www.g2g.com/categories/wow-classic-gold/offer/group?fa=lgc_29076_platform:lgc_29076_platform_59298"
  ],
  "maxItems": 200,
  "monitorMode": true,
  "watchWindow": 50,
  "minChangePercent": 2,
  "reportNewOffers": true
}
```

### Python

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>")
run_input = {'urls': ['https://www.g2g.com/categories/wow-classic-gold/offer/group?fa=lgc_29076_platform:lgc_29076_platform_59298'],
 'maxItems': 200,
 'monitorMode': True,
 'watchWindow': 50,
 'minChangePercent': 2,
 'reportNewOffers': True}
run = client.actor("fayoussef/g2g-offer-scraper").call(run_input=run_input)

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

### JavaScript / Node.js

```bash
npm install apify-client
```

```javascript
import { ApifyClient } from 'apify-client';

const client = new ApifyClient({ token: '<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>' });
const input = {
  "urls": [
    "https://www.g2g.com/categories/wow-classic-gold/offer/group?fa=lgc_29076_platform:lgc_29076_platform_59298"
  ],
  "maxItems": 200,
  "monitorMode": true,
  "watchWindow": 50,
  "minChangePercent": 2,
  "reportNewOffers": true
};
const run = await client.actor('fayoussef/g2g-offer-scraper').call(input);
const { items } = await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems();
console.log(items);
```

### cURL (run and get the results in one call)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~g2g-offer-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"urls": ["https://www.g2g.com/categories/wow-classic-gold/offer/group?fa=lgc_29076_platform:lgc_29076_platform_59298"], "maxItems": 200, "monitorMode": true, "watchWindow": 50, "minChangePercent": 2, "reportNewOffers": true}'
```

### From AI agents (MCP)

Add the Apify MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client with this URL, and the agent can run the actor for you:

```text
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fayoussef/g2g-offer-scraper
```

Your Apify API token is under **Settings > API & Integrations** in the [Apify Console](https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations?fpr=youssef).

### From AI agents with no Apify account (x402 or Skyfire)

This actor accepts [agentic payments](../agentic-payments.md): an AI agent can run it and pay per run with USDC (x402) or a Skyfire token, with no Apify account.

```bash
# x402: TOKEN is the prepaid token bought from Apify AGI with USDC on Base
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~g2g-offer-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'

# Skyfire: send the PAY token instead
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~g2g-offer-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "skyfire-pay-id: $SKYFIRE_PAY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'
```

With MCP and Skyfire: `https://mcp.apify.com?payment=skyfire&tools=fayoussef/g2g-offer-scraper`

## FAQ

### Is G2G Price Monitor: Undercut & Price Drop Alerts free to try?

Yes. You can start it with a free Apify account. Free runs have usage limits, and larger jobs need an [Apify plan](https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=youssef). The current rate is shown on the [Store page](https://apify.com/fayoussef/g2g-offer-scraper?fpr=youssef).

### Do I need to know how to code?

No. The actor runs from a form in the Apify Console. Code is only needed if you want to call it from your own app, and the snippets above cover Python, JavaScript and cURL.

### What formats can I export the data in?

JSON, CSV, Excel, XML and HTML from the Console, or directly through the Apify API. Runs can also be scheduled and pushed to Make, Zapier, n8n or any webhook.

### Can AI agents use it?

Yes. Connect the Apify MCP server with `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fayoussef/g2g-offer-scraper` and Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client can run it and read the results.

### Can an AI agent run it without an Apify account?

Yes. This actor accepts agentic payments: an agent can pay per run with USDC through the x402 protocol, or with a Skyfire PAY token, and no Apify account is needed. See [AI agents and x402 payments](../agentic-payments.md).

### Can I get a custom version?

Yes. Youssef Farhan builds custom scrapers and automations. Email youssefarhan24@gmail.com or visit [AutomationByExperts](https://automationbyexperts.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=web-scraping-apis).

## How to use XE.gr Greek Property Scraper

### No code

1. Open the actor on Apify and sign in, or create a free Apify account.
2. Fill in the input form, or paste the example input below, and click **Start**.
3. Download the results as JSON, CSV, Excel, XML or HTML, or send them to Make, Zapier, n8n or a webhook.

### Example input

```json
{
  "location": "Athens",
  "transactionType": "rent",
  "propertyCategory": "residence",
  "propertyType": "apartment",
  "minBedrooms": 1,
  "maxPrice": 900,
  "includePhone": true,
  "includeDetails": true,
  "sortBy": "publication_date_desc",
  "maxItems": 200
}
```

### Python

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>")
run_input = {'location': 'Athens',
 'transactionType': 'rent',
 'propertyCategory': 'residence',
 'propertyType': 'apartment',
 'minBedrooms': 1,
 'maxPrice': 900,
 'includePhone': True,
 'includeDetails': True,
 'sortBy': 'publication_date_desc',
 'maxItems': 200}
run = client.actor("fayoussef/xe-gr-scraper").call(run_input=run_input)

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

### JavaScript / Node.js

```bash
npm install apify-client
```

```javascript
import { ApifyClient } from 'apify-client';

const client = new ApifyClient({ token: '<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>' });
const input = {
  "location": "Athens",
  "transactionType": "rent",
  "propertyCategory": "residence",
  "propertyType": "apartment",
  "minBedrooms": 1,
  "maxPrice": 900,
  "includePhone": true,
  "includeDetails": true,
  "sortBy": "publication_date_desc",
  "maxItems": 200
};
const run = await client.actor('fayoussef/xe-gr-scraper').call(input);
const { items } = await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems();
console.log(items);
```

### cURL (run and get the results in one call)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~xe-gr-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"location": "Athens", "transactionType": "rent", "propertyCategory": "residence", "propertyType": "apartment", "minBedrooms": 1, "maxPrice": 900, "includePhone": true, "includeDetails": true, "sortBy": "publication_date_desc", "maxItems": 200}'
```

### From AI agents (MCP)

Add the Apify MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client with this URL, and the agent can run the actor for you:

```text
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fayoussef/xe-gr-scraper
```

Your Apify API token is under **Settings > API & Integrations** in the [Apify Console](https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations?fpr=youssef).

### From AI agents with no Apify account (x402 or Skyfire)

This actor accepts [agentic payments](../agentic-payments.md): an AI agent can run it and pay per run with USDC (x402) or a Skyfire token, with no Apify account.

```bash
# x402: TOKEN is the prepaid token bought from Apify AGI with USDC on Base
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~xe-gr-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'

# Skyfire: send the PAY token instead
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~xe-gr-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "skyfire-pay-id: $SKYFIRE_PAY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'
```

With MCP and Skyfire: `https://mcp.apify.com?payment=skyfire&tools=fayoussef/xe-gr-scraper`

## How to use Bike24 Scraper: Cycling Product Prices, Stock & Specs

### No code

1. Open the actor on Apify and sign in, or create a free Apify account.
2. Fill in the input form, or paste the example input below, and click **Start**.
3. Download the results as JSON, CSV, Excel, XML or HTML, or send them to Make, Zapier, n8n or a webhook.

### Example input

```json
{
  "start_urls": [
    {
      "url": "https://www.bike24.com/cycling/accessories/bike-bags/handlebar-bags"
    }
  ],
  "max_results": 200,
  "max_concurrency": 20
}
```

### Python

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>")
run_input = {'start_urls': [{'url': 'https://www.bike24.com/cycling/accessories/bike-bags/handlebar-bags'}],
 'max_results': 200,
 'max_concurrency': 20}
run = client.actor("fayoussef/bike24-result-scraper").call(run_input=run_input)

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

### JavaScript / Node.js

```bash
npm install apify-client
```

```javascript
import { ApifyClient } from 'apify-client';

const client = new ApifyClient({ token: '<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>' });
const input = {
  "start_urls": [
    {
      "url": "https://www.bike24.com/cycling/accessories/bike-bags/handlebar-bags"
    }
  ],
  "max_results": 200,
  "max_concurrency": 20
};
const run = await client.actor('fayoussef/bike24-result-scraper').call(input);
const { items } = await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems();
console.log(items);
```

### cURL (run and get the results in one call)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~bike24-result-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"start_urls": [{"url": "https://www.bike24.com/cycling/accessories/bike-bags/handlebar-bags"}], "max_results": 200, "max_concurrency": 20}'
```

### From AI agents (MCP)

Add the Apify MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client with this URL, and the agent can run the actor for you:

```text
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fayoussef/bike24-result-scraper
```

Your Apify API token is under **Settings > API & Integrations** in the [Apify Console](https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations?fpr=youssef).

### From AI agents with no Apify account (x402 or Skyfire)

This actor accepts [agentic payments](../agentic-payments.md): an AI agent can run it and pay per run with USDC (x402) or a Skyfire token, with no Apify account.

```bash
# x402: TOKEN is the prepaid token bought from Apify AGI with USDC on Base
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~bike24-result-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'

# Skyfire: send the PAY token instead
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~bike24-result-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "skyfire-pay-id: $SKYFIRE_PAY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'
```

With MCP and Skyfire: `https://mcp.apify.com?payment=skyfire&tools=fayoussef/bike24-result-scraper`

```json
  "maxResults": 300
}
```

### Python

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>")
run_input = {'searchUrl': 'https://www.centris.ca/en/properties~for-sale~montreal-island',
 'maxResults': 300}
run = client.actor("fayoussef/centris-property-scraper").call(run_input=run_input)

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

### JavaScript / Node.js

```bash
npm install apify-client
```

```javascript
import { ApifyClient } from 'apify-client';

const client = new ApifyClient({ token: '<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>' });
const input = {
  "searchUrl": "https://www.centris.ca/en/properties~for-sale~montreal-island",
  "maxResults": 300
};
const run = await client.actor('fayoussef/centris-property-scraper').call(input);
const { items } = await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems();
console.log(items);
```

### cURL (run and get the results in one call)

```bash

```

## FAQ

### Is Canada Car Scraper: AutoTrader.ca, Kijiji, CarGurus & Carpages free to try?

Yes. You can start it with a free Apify account. Free runs have usage limits, and larger jobs need an [Apify plan](https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=youssef). The current rate is shown on the [Store page](https://apify.com/fayoussef/canada-car-scraper?fpr=youssef).

### Do I need to know how to code?

No. The actor runs from a form in the Apify Console. Code is only needed if you want to call it from your own app, and the snippets above cover Python, JavaScript and cURL.

### What formats can I export the data in?

JSON, CSV, Excel, XML and HTML from the Console, or directly through the Apify API. Runs can also be scheduled and pushed to Make, Zapier, n8n or any webhook.

### Can AI agents use it?

Yes. Connect the Apify MCP server with `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fayoussef/canada-car-scraper` and Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client can run it and read the results.

### Can an AI agent run it without an Apify account?

Yes. This actor accepts agentic payments: an agent can pay per run with USDC through the x402 protocol, or with a Skyfire PAY token, and no Apify account is needed. See [AI agents and x402 payments](../agentic-payments.md).

### Can I get a custom version?

3. Download the results as JSON, CSV, Excel, XML or HTML, or send them to Make, Zapier, n8n or a webhook.

### Example input

```json
{

    "sf"
  ],
  "category": "ai",
  "fetchEventDetails": true,
  "maxEvents": 100
}
```

### Python

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>")
run_input = {'cities': ['sf'], 'category': 'ai', 'fetchEventDetails': True, 'maxEvents': 100}
run = client.actor("fayoussef/luma-events-scraper").call(run_input=run_input)

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

### JavaScript / Node.js

```bash
npm install apify-client
```

```javascript
import { ApifyClient } from 'apify-client';

const client = new ApifyClient({ token: '<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>' });
const input = {
  "cities": [
    "sf"
  ],
  "category": "ai",
  "fetchEventDetails": true,
  "maxEvents": 100
};
const run = await client.actor('fayoussef/luma-events-scraper').call(input);
const { items } = await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems();
console.log(items);
```

### cURL (run and get the results in one call)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~luma-events-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

```

```json
}
```

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
 'locations': ['Glyfada'],
 'language': 'en',

 'include_details': True}

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

### JavaScript / Node.js

```bash
npm install apify-client
```


```bash
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'

# Skyfire: send the PAY token instead

  -H "skyfire-pay-id: $SKYFIRE_PAY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'
```

# AI Account Watch: Custom Sales Trigger Alerts

**AI Account Watch: Custom Sales Trigger Alerts** is a ready-to-run Apify actor from AutomationByExperts by Youssef Farhan. Watch a list of companies and get alerted when one does what you describe in plain English: raises funding, hires a CMO, opens a location, gets sued. AI reads fresh Google News and alerts only on real, new events, to email, Slack or webhook.

[Run it on Apify](https://apify.com/fayoussef/ai-account-watch?fpr=youssef) | [Actor page on AutomationByExperts](https://automationbyexperts.com/apify/ai-account-watch?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=web-scraping-apis) | [All Lead Generation Actors](../categories/lead-generation.md)

## How to use AI Account Watch: Custom Sales Trigger Alerts

### No code

1. Open the actor on Apify and sign in, or create a free Apify account.
2. Fill in the input form, or paste the example input below, and click **Start**.
3. Download the results as JSON, CSV, Excel, XML or HTML, or send them to Make, Zapier, n8n or a webhook.

### Example input

Open the input form on the Store page to see every field. An empty input runs the defaults.

```json
{}
```

### Python

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>")
run_input = {}
run = client.actor("fayoussef/ai-account-watch").call(run_input=run_input)

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

### JavaScript / Node.js

```bash
npm install apify-client
```

```javascript
import { ApifyClient } from 'apify-client';

const client = new ApifyClient({ token: '<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>' });
const input = {};
const run = await client.actor('fayoussef/ai-account-watch').call(input);
const { items } = await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems();
console.log(items);
```

### cURL (run and get the results in one call)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~ai-account-watch/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

### From AI agents (MCP)

Add the Apify MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client with this URL, and the agent can run the actor for you:

```text
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fayoussef/ai-account-watch
```

Your Apify API token is under **Settings > API & Integrations** in the [Apify Console](https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations?fpr=youssef).

### From AI agents with no Apify account (x402 or Skyfire)

This actor accepts [agentic payments](../agentic-payments.md): an AI agent can run it and pay per run with USDC (x402) or a Skyfire token, with no Apify account.

```bash
# x402: TOKEN is the prepaid token bought from Apify AGI with USDC on Base
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~ai-account-watch/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'

# Skyfire: send the PAY token instead
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~ai-account-watch/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "skyfire-pay-id: $SKYFIRE_PAY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'
```

With MCP and Skyfire: `https://mcp.apify.com?payment=skyfire&tools=fayoussef/ai-account-watch`

## FAQ

### Is AI Account Watch: Custom Sales Trigger Alerts free to try?

Yes. You can start it with a free Apify account. Free runs have usage limits, and larger jobs need an [Apify plan](https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=youssef). The current rate is shown on the [Store page](https://apify.com/fayoussef/ai-account-watch?fpr=youssef).

### Do I need to know how to code?

No. The actor runs from a form in the Apify Console. Code is only needed if you want to call it from your own app, and the snippets above cover Python, JavaScript and cURL.

### What formats can I export the data in?

JSON, CSV, Excel, XML and HTML from the Console, or directly through the Apify API. Runs can also be scheduled and pushed to Make, Zapier, n8n or any webhook.

### Can AI agents use it?

Yes. Connect the Apify MCP server with `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fayoussef/ai-account-watch` and Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client can run it and read the results.

### Can an AI agent run it without an Apify account?

Yes. This actor accepts agentic payments: an agent can pay per run with USDC through the x402 protocol, or with a Skyfire PAY token, and no Apify account is needed. See [AI agents and x402 payments](../agentic-payments.md).

### Can I get a custom version?

Yes. Youssef Farhan builds custom scrapers and automations. Email youssefarhan24@gmail.com or visit [AutomationByExperts](https://automationbyexperts.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=web-scraping-apis).

## How to use Business YouTube Channel Finder: Subscribers & Activity

### No code

1. Open the actor on Apify and sign in, or create a free Apify account.
2. Fill in the input form, or paste the example input below, and click **Start**.
3. Download the results as JSON, CSV, Excel, XML or HTML, or send them to Make, Zapier, n8n or a webhook.

### Example input

```json
{
  "websites": [
    "rotorooter.com",
    "https://www.benjaminfranklinplumbing.com",
    "https://efficienttexas.com/",
    "https://www.kiddroof.com/",
    "https://www.servpro.com",
    "https://www.mrhandyman.com/"
  ],
  "searchYoutube": true,
  "includeUploads": true
}
```

### Python

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>")
run_input = {'websites': ['rotorooter.com',
              'https://www.benjaminfranklinplumbing.com',
              'https://efficienttexas.com/',
              'https://www.kiddroof.com/',
              'https://www.servpro.com',
              'https://www.mrhandyman.com/'],
 'searchYoutube': True,
 'includeUploads': True}
run = client.actor("fayoussef/business-youtube-channel-finder").call(run_input=run_input)

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

### JavaScript / Node.js

```bash
npm install apify-client
```

```javascript
import { ApifyClient } from 'apify-client';

const client = new ApifyClient({ token: '<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>' });
const input = {
  "websites": [
    "rotorooter.com",
    "https://www.benjaminfranklinplumbing.com",
    "https://efficienttexas.com/",
    "https://www.kiddroof.com/",
    "https://www.servpro.com",
    "https://www.mrhandyman.com/"
  ],
  "searchYoutube": true,
  "includeUploads": true
};
const run = await client.actor('fayoussef/business-youtube-channel-finder').call(input);
const { items } = await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems();
console.log(items);
```

### cURL (run and get the results in one call)


### From AI agents with no Apify account (x402 or Skyfire)

This actor accepts [agentic payments](../agentic-payments.md): an AI agent can run it and pay per run with USDC (x402) or a Skyfire token, with no Apify account.

```bash
# x402: TOKEN is the prepaid token bought from Apify AGI with USDC on Base
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~usda-report-watcher/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'

# Skyfire: send the PAY token instead
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~usda-report-watcher/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "skyfire-pay-id: $SKYFIRE_PAY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'
```

With MCP and Skyfire: `https://mcp.apify.com?payment=skyfire&tools=fayoussef/usda-report-watcher`

JSON, CSV, Excel, XML and HTML from the Console, or directly through the Apify API. Runs can also be scheduled and pushed to Make, Zapier, n8n or any webhook.

## How to use Greek Business Leads: New Business Alerts from XO.gr

### No code

1. Open the actor on Apify and sign in, or create a free Apify account.
2. Fill in the input form, or paste the example input below, and click **Start**.
3. Download the results as JSON, CSV, Excel, XML or HTML, or send them to Make, Zapier, n8n or a webhook.

### Example input

```json
{
  "search_terms": [
    "lawyers"
  ],
  "locations": [
    "Athens"
  ],
  "max_items": 200,
  "skip_sponsored": true,
  "include_details": false
}
```

### Python

```bash
pip install apify-client
```

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>")
run_input = {'search_terms': ['lawyers'],
 'locations': ['Athens'],
 'max_items': 200,
 'skip_sponsored': True,
 'include_details': False}
run = client.actor("fayoussef/xo-gr-scraper").call(run_input=run_input)

for item in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(item)
```

### JavaScript / Node.js

```bash
npm install apify-client
```

```javascript
import { ApifyClient } from 'apify-client';

const client = new ApifyClient({ token: '<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>' });
const input = {
  "search_terms": [
    "lawyers"
  ],
  "locations": [
    "Athens"
  ],
  "max_items": 200,
  "skip_sponsored": true,
  "include_details": false
};
const run = await client.actor('fayoussef/xo-gr-scraper').call(input);
const { items } = await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems();
console.log(items);
```

### cURL (run and get the results in one call)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~xo-gr-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"search_terms": ["lawyers"], "locations": ["Athens"], "max_items": 200, "skip_sponsored": true, "include_details": false}'
```

### From AI agents (MCP)

Add the Apify MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client with this URL, and the agent can run the actor for you:

```text
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fayoussef/xo-gr-scraper
```

Your Apify API token is under **Settings > API & Integrations** in the [Apify Console](https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations?fpr=youssef).

### From AI agents with no Apify account (x402 or Skyfire)

This actor accepts [agentic payments](../agentic-payments.md): an AI agent can run it and pay per run with USDC (x402) or a Skyfire token, with no Apify account.

```bash
# x402: TOKEN is the prepaid token bought from Apify AGI with USDC on Base
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~xo-gr-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'

# Skyfire: send the PAY token instead
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/fayoussef~xo-gr-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items" \
  -H "skyfire-pay-id: $SKYFIRE_PAY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'
```

With MCP and Skyfire: `https://mcp.apify.com?payment=skyfire&tools=fayoussef/xo-gr-scraper`

## FAQ

### Is Greek Business Leads: New Business Alerts from XO.gr free to try?

Yes. You can start it with a free Apify account. Free runs have usage limits, and larger jobs need an [Apify plan](https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=youssef). The current rate is shown on the [Store page](https://apify.com/fayoussef/xo-gr-scraper?fpr=youssef).

### Do I need to know how to code?

No. The actor runs from a form in the Apify Console. Code is only needed if you want to call it from your own app, and the snippets above cover Python, JavaScript and cURL.

### What formats can I export the data in?

JSON, CSV, Excel, XML and HTML from the Console, or directly through the Apify API. Runs can also be scheduled and pushed to Make, Zapier, n8n or any webhook.

### Can AI agents use it?

Yes. Connect the Apify MCP server with `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fayoussef/xo-gr-scraper` and Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client can run it and read the results.

### Can an AI agent run it without an Apify account?

Yes. This actor accepts agentic payments: an agent can pay per run with USDC through the x402 protocol, or with a Skyfire PAY token, and no Apify account is needed. See [AI agents and x402 payments](../agentic-payments.md).

### Can I get a custom version?

Yes. Youssef Farhan builds custom scrapers and automations. Email youssefarhan24@gmail.com or visit [AutomationByExperts](https://automationbyexperts.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=web-scraping-apis).
